about: PHOTO-REUSE: photos allowed on more than two screens in the normal demo (owner decision 9.12: one photo on at most two screens). Each entry: a regex for the photo's file name (without its hash) and why. Photos shown 64 px or smaller (avatars) are never counted: an avatar is its owner's build photo by design (9.12).

allow.why: The user's own car: it is meant to show on Garage, Me and It's up (owner decision 9.15, 20 Nov 2026).
